recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內一條粗大、玻璃樣變的膠原纖維帶（粉紅色、細胞稀少）伸入皮質下區，緊鄰上方一個大型反應性濾泡，生發中心含可染體巨噬細胞並有完整套區，呈纖維化合併濾泡增生的發炎性偽瘤樣變化。
features: Broad band of dense, hypocellular, hyalinized collagen extending into the subcortical region
Thin strands of fibrosis radiating from the collagen band into surrounding lymphoid tissue
Adjacent large reactive secondary follicle with a well-defined mantle zone
Germinal center containing scattered tingible body macrophages (starry pattern)
Surrounding paracortex with mixed small lymphocytes and prominent small vessels
describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows a broad band of dense, hypocellular hyalinized collagen extending into the subcortical area, with thinner fibrous strands radiating into the adjacent lymphoid tissue. A large reactive secondary follicle lies next to the fibrotic focus, with a well-formed mantle zone and a germinal center containing tingible body macrophages. The surrounding paracortex contains mixed small lymphocytes and small vessels without an atypical infiltrate. Findings are consistent with the fibrosclerotic pattern of nodal inflammatory pseudotumor with associated reactive follicular hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: NSCHL shows collagen bands encircling nodules that contain lacunar and Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+, CD15+, PAX5 dim), which must be excluded by searching for these cells and immunostaining.
IgG4-related disease has storiform fibrosis with obliterative phlebitis and IgG4+ plasma cells >100/HPF with IgG4/IgG ratio >40%, whereas IgG4+ cells were only mildly increased in this case.

IMT forms a mass of fascicular myofibroblasts with frequent ALK rearrangement and ALK immunopositivity, whereas nodal inflammatory pseudotumor is a reactive, usually ALK-negative, capsule-and-trabecula-based process.
